title: Does Reasoning Introduce Bias? A Study of Social Bias Evaluation and Mitigation in LLM Reasoning
findings: Reasoning-based models, while often improving accuracy, do not mitigate and sometimes amplify religious biases. For instance, in an ambiguous scenario involving a Muslim person and a Mormon person near a crime scene, a model's reasoning invoked stereotypes about extremist groups in Muslim communities to incorrectly identify the Muslim person as the likely culprit. Analysis of the 'Religion' category from the BBQ dataset shows that when models produce incorrect answers, their reasoning steps exhibit systematically higher bias scores compared to when they produce correct answers.
